shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台打开盖子的台式离心机旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an open benchtop centrifuge on a lab bench and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲离心机的清洁维护和转子检查。
overlay: 离心机的清洁维护与转子检查

shots.scene: 清洁、消毒、润滑、检查、记录五个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row from left to right: a cleaning cloth, a spray bottle, a small grease tube, a magnifying glass and a blank clipboard. No people.
shots.narration: 清洁、消毒、润滑、检查，还要记录。

shots.scene: 阿杰打开离心机盖，转子腔里有一圈白色盐渍
shots.prompt_en: The young male student opens the lid of a benchtop centrifuge and frowns at a ring of white salt crust inside the rotor chamber.
shots.narration: 阿杰打开离心机，腔里有一圈白色盐渍。

shots.scene: 转子孔边缘有暗色斑点的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a dark centrifuge rotor with small dull spots and a faint stain around one tube hole. No people.
shots.narration: 转子孔边，也有些发暗的小斑点。

shots.scene: 阿杰耸耸肩，伸手准备直接合盖开机
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shrugs and reaches to close the lid and press the start button.
shots.narration: 他想：能转就行，先用了再说。

shots.scene: 小研抬手拦住阿杰，指向转子上的斑点
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student raises her hand to stop him and points at the spots on the rotor.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：腐蚀的转子，高速下可能出事。

shots.scene: 老李拿着工具箱走过来点头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks over carrying a toolbox and nods at both students.
shots.narration: 老李说：今天正好一起做一次维护。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在离心机旁竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to the centrifuge and gives a thumbs-up.
shots.narration: 我们按步骤来。

shots.section_title: 定期维护是安全的基础
shots.scene: 欣欣拍拍离心机机身
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pats the housing of a benchtop centrifuge.
shots.narration: 离心机转速很高，状态好才安全。
overlay: 定期维护是安全的基础

shots.section_title: 定期维护是安全的基础
shots.scene: 日历上每隔一段画一个扳手图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank wall calendar with a small wrench icon marked at regular intervals. No people.
shots.narration: 所以要定期维护，不能坏了才管。

shots.section_title: 定期维护是安全的基础
shots.scene: 干净的离心机和转子并排，旁边一个盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: A clean centrifuge and a clean rotor side by side with a shield icon above them. No people.
shots.narration: 维护得好，设备寿命长，用着也放心。

shots.scene: 小研按下离心机电源开关
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat and goggles presses the power switch of the centrifuge to turn it off.
shots.narration: 第一步，先关闭离心机。

shots.scene: 小研用转子扳手松开中心螺母，双手取出转子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student uses a T-shaped rotor key to loosen the center nut, then lifts the rotor out with both gloved hands.
shots.narration: 用专用扳手松开，双手取下转子。

shots.scene: 转子和扳手平放在铺了软垫的台面上
shots.prompt_en: The removed rotor and the T-shaped key lie on a soft mat on the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 转子放在平稳的软垫上，别磕碰。

shots.scene: 一瓶空白标签的清洗剂，旁边是标着中性的天平图标
shots.prompt_en: A detergent bottle with a blank label next to a balanced scale icon. No people.
shots.narration: 清洁用中性清洗剂。

shots.scene: 小研用拧干的软布擦拭机壳外面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the outside housing of the centrifuge with a well-wrung soft cloth.
shots.narration: 机壳外面擦一擦。

shots.scene: 小研用软布擦拭转子腔内壁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the inside wall of the empty rotor chamber with a soft cloth.
shots.narration: 转子腔和各种附件，也要擦干净。

shots.scene: 强酸强碱清洁剂瓶和钢丝球图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a harsh cleaner bottle and a steel wool pad, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不用强酸强碱，也不用钢丝球。

shots.section_title: 擦净盐垢和腐蚀性残留
shots.scene: 转子腔底部白色盐垢的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of white salt crust around the drive shaft at the bottom of the rotor chamber. No people.
shots.narration: 看到盐垢或化学品残留，要特别注意。
overlay: 擦净盐垢和腐蚀性残留

shots.section_title: 擦净盐垢和腐蚀性残留
shots.scene: 小研用纸巾仔细擦拭驱动轴周围
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carefully wipes around the drive shaft with a paper towel.
shots.narration: 把残留彻底擦掉，不留死角。

shots.section_title: 擦净盐垢和腐蚀性残留
shots.scene: 离心机旁浮现一个沙漏和向上箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: A centrifuge with an hourglass icon and an upward arrow floating beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 这样设备能用得更久。

shots.scene: 小研把转子拿到水槽边
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carries the rotor with both hands to a lab sink.
shots.narration: 转子也要同样清洁。

shots.scene: 小研用软布擦洗转子表面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student scrubs the rotor surface with a soft cloth at the sink.
shots.narration: 盐和化学品留在上面，会加速腐蚀。

shots.scene: 转子表面的盐粒变成锈斑的示意动画
shots.prompt_en: Simple animation: small salt grains on a metal rotor surface slowly turn into rust spots. No people.
shots.narration: 腐蚀从小斑点开始，悄悄变大。

shots.section_title: 用非金属头刷子刷转子孔
shots.scene: 一把细长试管刷，刷头末端有刷毛、塑料头
shots.prompt_en: A long thin test tube brush with bristles at the very end and a plastic tip. No people.
shots.narration: 转子孔用硬毛试管刷。
overlay: 用非金属头刷子刷转子孔

shots.section_title: 用非金属头刷子刷转子孔
shots.scene: 小研用试管刷逐个刷洗转子孔
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student brushes the tube holes of the rotor one by one with the test tube brush.
shots.narration: 一个孔一个孔，刷到底部。

shots.section_title: 用非金属头刷子刷转子孔
shots.scene: 金属头刷子划伤孔壁的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a metal-tipped brush scratching a hole wall, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 金属头会划伤孔壁，不要用。

shots.section_title: 清水冲洗，不要整体浸泡
shots.scene: 小研把转子拿在水龙头下冲洗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the rotor under a running tap and rinses it.
shots.narration: 刷完用清水冲洗。
overlay: 清水冲洗，不要整体浸泡

shots.section_title: 清水冲洗，不要整体浸泡
shots.scene: 转子整个泡在水盆里的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a rotor fully submerged in a basin of water, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 但不要把转子整个泡进水里。

shots.section_title: 清水冲洗，不要整体浸泡
shots.scene: 转子倒扣在架子上沥水
shots.prompt_en: The rotor sits upside down on a drying rack beside the sink, water dripping off. No people.
shots.narration: 冲完倒扣沥干，让孔里的水流出来。

shots.section_title: 必要时用醇类消毒液消毒
shots.scene: 一瓶空白标签的消毒液和一块干净软布
shots.prompt_en: A spray bottle with a blank label next to a clean soft cloth. No people.
shots.narration: 需要时，再用醇类消毒液消毒。
overlay: 必要时用醇类消毒液消毒

shots.section_title: 必要时用醇类消毒液消毒
shots.scene: 小研用沾了消毒液的软布擦拭转子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the rotor with a cloth lightly dampened with disinfectant.
shots.narration: 可用百分之七十异丙醇等稀释醇类。

shots.section_title: 必要时用醇类消毒液消毒
shots.scene: 冲洗、消毒两个图标，中间一个箭头
shots.prompt_en: Two icons with an arrow between them: a water tap, then a spray bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 顺序是：先水洗，后消毒。

shots.scene: 转子、转子盖和一支空白润滑脂软管摆在台面上
shots.prompt_en: A clean rotor, its lid and a small blank grease tube laid out on the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 洗净、消毒、晾干后，再润滑。

shots.scene: 戴手套的指尖挤上一点点润滑脂
shots.prompt_en: A gloved fingertip receives a tiny dab of grease squeezed from the tube.
shots.narration: 取一点点专用润滑脂在指尖。

shots.scene: 小研给转子盖螺纹和橡胶密封圈薄薄涂一层
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student spreads a thin layer of grease on the lid threads and the rubber seal ring.
shots.narration: 涂在螺纹和橡胶密封圈上。

shots.scene: 吊篮槽、枢轴、密封圈、螺纹四个位置用圆圈标出
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a swing-bucket rotor with four small circles marking the bucket grooves, pivots, seal ring and threads. No people.
shots.narration: 吊篮槽和枢轴也要照顾到。

shots.scene: 厚厚一团润滑脂的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a big blob of grease, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 薄薄一层就够，多了反而粘灰。

shots.scene: 小研举起转子对着灯光仔细查看
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the rotor up to the light and inspects it closely.
shots.narration: 润滑之后，仔细检查转子。

shots.scene: 放大镜下看到转子孔边一道细小裂纹
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over the rim of a rotor hole reveals a hairline crack. No people.
shots.narration: 找细小的裂纹，

shots.scene: 放大镜下看到孔底的腐蚀斑点
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over the bottom of a rotor hole reveals small corrosion pits. No people.
shots.narration: 也找腐蚀斑点，孔底和边缘都要看。

shots.scene: 有裂纹的转子旁亮起红色停止图标
shots.prompt_en: A cracked rotor with a red stop icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 发现任何损伤，

shots.scene: 老李把有裂纹的转子换成一只新转子
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer replaces the cracked rotor with a new one on the bench.
shots.narration: 这个转子就要立即更换，不能再用。

shots.section_title: 拿不准，请专业人员检查
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着转子，头顶冒出问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a rotor and looks unsure, a question mark above his head.
shots.narration: 看不准有没有问题怎么办？
overlay: 拿不准，请专业人员检查

shots.section_title: 拿不准，请专业人员检查
shots.scene: 阿杰把转子交给老李
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hands the rotor to the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 别凭感觉，交给专业维修人员检查。

shots.section_title: 拿不准，请专业人员检查
shots.scene: 老李打电话，旁边一个空白的设备报修单
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer makes a phone call next to a blank equipment repair form.
shots.narration: 可联系设备管理部门或厂家授权维修。

shots.section_title: 长期腐蚀让离心不安全
shots.scene: 腐蚀性试剂瓶图标和转子之间画着一条长长的时间线
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of a corrosive reagent bottle and a rotor connected by a long timeline arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 长期接触腐蚀性化学品，
overlay: 长期腐蚀让离心不安全

shots.section_title: 长期腐蚀让离心不安全
shots.scene: 转子和吊篮表面的腐蚀逐渐扩大的示意图
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a rotor and a swing bucket whose surface corrosion spreads step by step. No people.
shots.narration: 转子和吊篮会慢慢被腐蚀。

shots.section_title: 长期腐蚀让离心不安全
shots.scene: 高速旋转的转子示意图，旁边一个警告三角
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a spinning rotor with motion lines and a general warning sign beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 高速旋转时，受损转子就成了隐患。

shots.scene: 老李在实验台前逐个检查几只转子
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a work coat and goggles examines several rotors one by one at a bench.
shots.narration: 专业检测由受过培训的技术人员做。

shots.scene: 细长的内窥镜探头伸进转子孔，屏幕显示孔内图像
shots.prompt_en: A thin borescope probe goes into a rotor hole while a monitor shows a magnified view of the inside.
shots.narration: 用内窥镜，看清孔内看不到的地方。

shots.scene: 老李在空白检测表上打勾
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer ticks boxes on a blank inspection form on a clipboard.
shots.narration: 检测结果写进记录。

shots.scene: 转子侧面贴上一枚空白圆形检测标签
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand sticks a small blank round inspection label on the side of the rotor.
shots.narration: 检测过的转子贴上标识，一目了然。

shots.section_title: 预防性维护，查阅说明书
shots.scene: 日历上的预防性维护日期被圈出
shots.prompt_en: A blank calendar with a future date circled and a wrench icon on it. No people.
shots.narration: 要求高的实验室，做预防性维护。
overlay: 预防性维护，查阅说明书

shots.section_title: 预防性维护，查阅说明书
shots.scene: 小研翻开一本空白封面的离心机说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a centrifuge operating manual with a blank cover.
shots.narration: 具体方法，以说明书为准。

shots.section_title: 预防性维护，查阅说明书
shots.scene: 墙上贴着一张空白的维护流程图海报
shots.prompt_en: A blank maintenance flowchart poster with simple icons hangs on the wall next to the centrifuge. No people.
shots.narration: 维护流程贴在设备旁，随时对照。

shots.scene: 王老师给小研和阿杰讲解离心机，旁边一块空白培训板
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains a benchtop centrifuge to the female graduate student and the young male student beside a blank training board.
shots.narration: 使用和维护离心机，先经过培训。

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白的培训考核表上签名
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs a blank training record form.
shots.narration: 考核合格，才能独立使用。

shots.scene: 离心机旁挂着一份空白的操作规程卡
shots.prompt_en: A blank operating procedure card hangs on the wall beside the centrifuge. No people.
shots.narration: 按本实验室的操作和维护规程来。

shots.scene: 小研拔下离心机电源插头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student unplugs the centrifuge power cord from the wall socket.
shots.narration: 维护前关机，还要拔下电源插头。

shots.scene: 转子停稳后才打开盖子的示意：转动线条消失、盖子打开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: motion lines around the rotor fade away completely, then the lid opens. No people.
shots.narration: 确认转子完全停稳再开盖。

shots.scene: 小研穿实验服，戴护目镜和手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat puts on safety goggles and nitrile gloves.
shots.narration: 穿实验服，戴护目镜和手套。

shots.scene: 液体流进电机缝隙的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of liquid dripping into the motor gap of a centrifuge, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 布要拧干，别让液体流进电机。

shots.scene: 转子腔里一只破裂的离心管，旁边生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: A cracked tube lies inside the rotor chamber with a biohazard warning sign beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 如果离心过感染性样品，或管子破了，

shots.scene: 盖着的离心机旁一个沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: A closed centrifuge with an hourglass icon above it. No people.
shots.narration: 先别急着开盖，让气溶胶沉降。

shots.scene: 小研在生物安全柜里打开密封转子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a sealed rotor inside a biosafety cabinet.
shots.narration: 密封转子在生物安全柜里打开。

shots.scene: 王老师递给小研一份空白的去污规程
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands the female graduate student a blank decontamination procedure sheet.
shots.narration: 按本实验室生物安全规程去污，并报告。

shots.scene: 消毒液瓶上贴着易燃标志，远处有火焰图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A disinfectant bottle with a flammable warning sign; a separate flame icon nearby is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 醇类消毒液易燃，远离火源。

shots.scene: 通风良好的台面上，转子晾干
shots.prompt_en: A rotor drying on a bench in a well-ventilated lab with an air flow icon. No people.
shots.narration: 少量使用，通风晾干再装回、再通电。

shots.scene: 消毒液瓶和转子之间一个问号，旁边是说明书
shots.prompt_en: A question mark between a disinfectant bottle and a metal rotor, next to an operating manual. No people.
shots.narration: 消毒剂要和转子材料相容。

shots.scene: 含氯消毒液瓶倒在金属转子上的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bleach bottle pouring onto a metal rotor, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 有的消毒剂会腐蚀金属，查说明书。

shots.scene: 转子侧面一个计数器图标
shots.prompt_en: A rotor with a small counter icon next to it. No people.
shots.narration: 转子有使用寿命和次数限制。

shots.scene: 超过寿命的转子旁一个向下箭头和停止图标
shots.prompt_en: An old rotor with a downward arrow and a stop icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 到期降速或报废，以说明书为准。

shots.scene: 小研在空白的使用维护登记本上填写
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes in a blank equipment use and maintenance logbook beside the centrifuge.
shots.narration: 每次使用和维护，都要登记。

shots.scene: 登记本旁浮现日期、转子编号、检查结果三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons float above the logbook: a calendar, a rotor and a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 写清日期、转子、做了什么、谁做的。

shots.section_title: 损坏设备停用挂牌与报修
shots.scene: 老李在离心机上挂一块空白的停用牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer hangs a blank out-of-service tag on the centrifuge.
shots.narration: 设备或转子有问题，马上停用挂牌。
overlay: 损坏设备停用挂牌与报修

shots.section_title: 损坏设备停用挂牌与报修
shots.scene: 阿杰向老周报告，老周点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports to the older man, who listens and nods.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人，走报修流程。

shots.section_title: 损坏设备停用挂牌与报修
shots.scene: 螺丝刀拆机身的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a screwdriver opening a centrifuge housing, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不自行拆修，由专业人员维修。

shots.scene: 小研把沾了化学品的抹布放进有空白标签的废物桶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student drops used cleaning cloths into a closed waste bin with a blank label.
shots.narration: 沾了化学品的抹布纸巾，分类收集。

shots.scene: 生物污染的擦拭物放进带生物危害标志的废物袋
shots.prompt_en: Used wipes go into a waste bag with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 有生物污染的，按医疗废物要求处理。

shots.scene: 倒向水槽的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of chemical liquid poured into a sink drain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 含化学品的废液，不倒下水道。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现插头、布和刷子图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a power plug, a cloth and a test tube brush.
shots.narration: 断电取转子，中性清洗，刷孔冲洗。

shots.scene: 消毒液、润滑脂、放大镜图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a spray bottle, a grease tube and a magnifying glass in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 消毒晾干，薄涂润滑，细查裂纹腐蚀。

shots.scene: 停用牌和报修单图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank out-of-service tag and a blank repair form. No people.
shots.narration: 有损伤就停用更换，拿不准就报修。

shots.scene: 登记本和生物危害标志图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a logbook and a biohazard warning sign side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 污染先去污，维护要记录。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在擦得锃亮的离心机旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera beside a clean, shiny benchtop centrifuge.
shots.narration: 勤维护，常检查，离心更安全，下次见！
